docs.summary: Turns the effect spans covering a glyph into the transform it should be drawn with. Every effect is a pure function of (glyph index, time, parameters), so the same time always produces the same frame. A paused game genuinely pauses and screenshots reproduce. Effects fall into three rhythms, which is what makes them read differently on screen: some march along the text as a travelling wave, some move every glyph in step, and some give each glyph its own phase so the run looks alive rather than mechanical.

docs.summary: Compose every effect covering `index` into one transform.

params.index: Character index into the visible text.
params.effects: Spans from the parser. Only those covering the index contribute.
params.time: Seconds on any steady clock. Every effect repeats over time, so where it starts does not matter.
params.pixelSize: Font pixel size, so movement scales with the text.
params.baseColor: The glyph's colour before any colour effect.
